observations: WebArena shopping has the strongest cross-site structure of any benchmark: 12 store instances share search/add-to-cart/checkout action patterns with explicit intent_template + instantiation_dict for parameterized tasks

Mind2Web provides the best novelty fraction measurement: official 3-way split (test_task/test_website/test_domain) enables controlled training on subsets of task instances and testing on unseen instances of the same mechanism
WebArena shopping M1=1.0, M2=0.8 but M3=false (no official instance-level splits); Mind2Web M1=0.82, M2=0.65, M3=true; these two benchmarks are complementary for C-LLM-INHERIT testing
VisualWebArena shares WebArena shopping instances but adds visual grounding requirement; M1=1.0 but M2=0.3 (visual tasks less parameterizable by text templates)
AgentBench web component is Mind2Web; no independent benchmark structure for web tasks
HMT (Hierarchical Memory Tree) directly tests stage-level pre/post-condition matching on WebArena+Mind2Web; its benchmark structure choices directly inform C-LLM-INHERIT experiment design
WebCoach uses trajectory-level FAISS memory on WebVoyager (live web); tests memory reuse but NOT mechanism-level parameterized inheritance
AgentRR is deterministic record-and-replay debugging; NOT relevant to mechanism inheritance claims
Positive control passes: WebArena shopping has cross-site pairs (M1=1.0) and parameterized templates (M2=0.8)
Null control passes: WebArena wikipedia has 0 cross-site pairs (M1=0.0) and minimal parameterization (M2=0.1)
SPIDER's 2-site corpus remains the lower bound; all four benchmarks provide strictly more structural diversity for mechanism inheritance testing
validity_notes: All analysis is structural (source code + documentation inspection), not live execution. No Docker deployment, no browser automation, no LLM API calls. Claims are about benchmark task structure, not SPIDER's actual performance on these benchmarks.

WebArena task count discrepancy: README says 812 total tasks but shopping alone has 996 tasks across 12 instances. The 812 count may refer to unique task definitions before instantiation across store instances. This does not affect structural analysis.

Mind2Web task definitions require HuggingFace dataset access (git clone from hf.co). Structural analysis is based on published paper (NeurIPS 2023) and README documentation, not direct dataset inspection.

M2 (parameterization) scores are estimated from task definition structure, not measured from actual task instances. Mind2Web operations (CLICK/TYPE/SELECT) inherently have variable fields (element_id, input_value) but exact parameterization fraction requires dataset inspection.

M3 (novelty fraction) for WebArena is scored as false because no official instance-level splits exist, even though splits could be defined manually. Mind2Web's official splits are the only pre-defined instance-level splits among the four benchmarks.
VisualWebArena's M2=0.3 reflects that visual tasks (requiring image understanding) are less amenable to text-template parameterization than WebArena's text-only tasks.
unresolved: Whether WebArena's 996 shopping tasks vs 812 total tasks discrepancy indicates per-instance task duplication or genuinely different task definitions across stores. If tasks are duplicated across stores, cross-site mechanism transfer may be less meaningful than if tasks are unique per store.

Whether Mind2Web's cross-website split provides true cross-site mechanism transfer or merely tests generalization to new website layouts. The split ensures unseen websites but same domains; true cross-site transfer requires same mechanism across structurally different sites.

Whether HMT's stage-level pre/post-condition matching (tested on WebArena+Mind2Web) can be directly adapted for SPIDER's mechanism inheritance. HMT is memory-augmented; SPIDER's inheritance is kernel-level.
Whether the 31x recipe material gap (EXP-INTEL-35264637598) is addressable using WebArena's 996 shopping tasks as additional training data for C-LLM-INHERIT.
Whether VisualWebArena's visual grounding requirement conflicts with SPIDER's text-based fragment model. VisualWebArena tasks require image understanding; SPIDER's fragments are text/HTML-based.
